name: notebooklm-login-service
description: Companion service: runs a real browser login for NotebookLM (via notebooklm-py's Playwright flow) and hands the captured session cookie to the Supabase-backed bridge. Never runs unattended; only during an explicit user-initiated 'Connect NotebookLM' action.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install 'notebooklm-py[browser]' && playwright install chromium
